description: Search the Colorado Revised Statutes GENERAL INDEX by topic and get back matching index entries with their C.R.S. citations — e.g. "landlord", "security deposit", "concealed handgun", "driving under the influence". This is a real subject-index search, not just a title list: it finds the specific section(s) a plain-English topic maps to so you can pass them to co_statute. Works best with a SHORT topic (1-3 words) — the index is a nested tree (a topic heading followed by indented sub-entries that do not repeat the heading word), matched here within a small window of nearby lines, so a long compound phrase can miss or pick up a loosely related neighbor. Keyless.

query.description: Topic to search for, e.g. "landlord", "security deposit", "concealed handgun". Short phrases work best.
